**Limitations**

- The contrast factor depends on the image, so the same scene at another contrast gives other keypoints.
- Only the detector runs. The binary descriptors are not computed.

**Artifacts**

- On the Siemens star, no keypoint lies within 39 pixels of the center, where the spokes are fine. 104 of the 246 lie on the rim, where the spokes meet the gray ground.
